question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this experimental Claws workspace-file lifecycle as a core product surface, including its filesystem ownership and SQLite provenance contract?
rationale: The PR introduces new user-facing mutation behavior and persisted provenance in a stacked experimental system; the protected maintainer label and unresolved RFC sponsorship require an owner decision beyond mechanical review.

options.title: Sponsor the Claws slice
options.body: Confirm the experimental core direction, then complete final-head compatibility and filesystem-boundary review before merge.

options.title: Keep planning read-only
options.body: Defer workspace-file mutation and retain only the parent planning or agent-creation work until the lifecycle direction is approved.

options.title: Move lifecycle ownership elsewhere
options.body: Decline this core workflow if maintainers prefer an external package or plugin model for Claw-managed workspaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Claws slice
recommendation.body: Confirm the experimental core direction, then complete final-head compatibility and filesystem-boundary review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment states the central workspace identity and fs-safe invariants that determine whether this lifecycle is acceptable.
